$comment: Target groups registry. ONE post per group per run.
posting_code = NAME of the flow function implementing that group's composer layout
(poster/flows.py::<code>). Flows are keyed by LAYOUT, not by group: many groups share
one code (group_composer_es_v1 = Spanish composer). Unknown code = hard error, never
guess. A new group whose layout already has a flow needs only a successful dry run
(ap-status stamp) — record ONLY to build a flow for a new layout.
photos_order: 'sorted' = car subfolders of data/car_photos in name order (NN_ prefixes).
Optional 'recording': ap-record dump dir this flow was built from (auto-detected from .local-capture when omitted).
Index of states is computed by `poetry run python -m poster.main --status` (alias: ap-status).
